# QR Code generator library

- Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
- Version: `v1.8.0`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` and the notices in both source files.
- Files: unmodified upstream `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp`, `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp`, and

- Purpose: encode Quark login URLs locally without sharing authentication
  tokens with an external QR image service.
